verdict.rationale: Mercury Books includes Command, a built-in AI assistant that answers plain-language questions about spend, trends and GL codes, with answers grounded in the user's account data. Mercury also documents AI-driven GL code suggestions on transactions, so the product delivers in-product AI insights and suggestions from user data. Missing for 10: proactive or unprompted insights (insights are shown only on ask, apart from GL suggestions), and independent or hands-on corroboration of answer quality; all evidence is vendor marketing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ask Command anything about your finances — spend, trends, GL codes — and get immediate answers grounded in your account data
Ask Mercury Command a question about your books, or hand off a bookkeeping task to it directly, in plain language.
Transactions on Mercury are now automatically assigned GL codes based on your categorization history and AI-driven suggestions
